title: New Year From Joel — EN/HI/SW (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Hindi Swahili language learning warm baritone 100bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual brothers family New Year true story
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
New Year's Eve. Perth time. Joel called. No answer.
"Just calling to wish you the best in the new year bro."
Give the kids a big cuddle. Kiss on their forehead. From me.
Love your little bro.

[Verse 2 - Hindi, with English translations]
नए साल की रात। पर्थ समय। जोएल ने फोन किया। कोई जवाब नहीं। (New Year's Eve. Perth time. Joel called. No answer.)
"बस नए साल में तुम्हें शुभकामनाएं देने के लिए फोन किया था भाई।" (Just calling to wish you the best in the new year bro.)
बच्चों को बड़ा गले लगाओ। माथे पर चुंबन। मेरी तरफ से। (Give the kids a big cuddle. Kiss on their forehead. From me.)
अपने छोटे भाई का प्यार। (Love your little bro.)
वह कह नहीं सका "जोएल"। (He didn't sign off as "Joel".)
उसने "तेरा छोटा भाई" लिखा। (He wrote "your little bro".)
यही वह पूरा आदमी है। (That's the whole man.)

[Chorus - Swahili, with English translations]
Piga watoto kukumbatia (Give the kids a cuddle)
Busu kwenye paji la uso (Kiss on the forehead)
Kutoka kwa ndugu yako mdogo (From your little bro)
Piga watoto kukumbatia (Give the kids a cuddle)
Nakupenda nakukosa (Love you and miss ya)
Heri ya mwaka mpya (Happy new year)
Piga watoto kukumbatia (Give the kids a cuddle)
Joel alisema hivyo (Joel said that)
Saa tisa usiku (At ten twenty-three at night)
Kutoka Perth (From Perth)
Mguu uliovunjika (Broken leg)
Haikujalisha (Didn't matter)
Alisema hivyo hata hivyo (Said it anyway)

[Bridge - all three]
English: "Love your little bro." He signed off that way. Not his name. Your little bro.
Hindi: "अपने छोटे भाई का प्यार।" उसने इस तरह हस्ताक्षर किए। अपने नाम से नहीं। तेरा छोटा भाई। (Love your little bro. Signed off that way. Not his name. Your little bro.)
Swahili: "Penda ndugu yako mdogo." Alihitimisha hivyo. Si jina lake. Ndugu yako mdogo. (Love your little bro. He signed off that way. Not his name. Your little bro.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Happy new year — love your little bro — from Joel
Hindi: नए साल की शुभकामनाएं — तेरे छोटे भाई का प्यार — जोएल की तरफ से (Happy new year — love your little bro — from Joel)
Swahili: Heri ya mwaka mpya — penda ndugu yako mdogo — kutoka Joel (Happy new year — love your little bro — from Joel)
